member.name: T:Ahmodi.Core.GaloisField256
member.summary: Provides high-performance arithmetic operations over Galois Field GF(2^8) using the standard Reed-Solomon primitive polynomial P(x) = x^8 + x^4 + x^3 + x^2 + 1 (0x11D = 285). (Note: AES/Rijndael uses 0x11B; 0x11D is the standard in erasure coding specifications including RFC 5510, CCSDS, and Intel ISA-L).

member.name: F:Ahmodi.Core.GaloisField256.Polynomial
member.summary: The primitive irreducible polynomial for GF(2^8) Reed-Solomon: x^8 + x^4 + x^3 + x^2 + 1 (0x11D).

member.name: F:Ahmodi.Core.GaloisField256.LogTable
member.summary: Discrete logarithm lookup table (base alpha = 2).

member.name: F:Ahmodi.Core.GaloisField256.ExpTable
member.summary: Discrete exponent lookup table (base alpha = 2), duplicated across 512 entries to avoid modulo operations during multiplication.

member.name: F:Ahmodi.Core.GaloisField256.InverseTable
member.summary: Multiplicative inverse lookup table for all 256 field elements.
